title: Live Dashboards on Operational Data: TiDB HTAP with Power BI
tagline: One TiDB cluster feeds the order pipeline and the Power BI report at the same time, with no nightly ETL job in between.
pattern: Business teams that want live dashboards on operational data without a nightly ETL job into a separate warehouse.

metrics.label: Dashboard query p50 (TiKV)
metrics.howMeasured: Once per tick, a dedicated connection runs SET SESSION tidb_isolation_read_engines='tikv', then each of the 3 queries in DASHBOARD_QUERIES is timed with timed(); summarize() over that tick's samples gives p50.

metrics.label: Dashboard query p99 (TiKV)
metrics.howMeasured: Same measurement as dashboard-p50-tikv; this is the p99 field of the same summarize() result for the tick.

metrics.label: Dashboard query p50 (TiFlash)
metrics.howMeasured: Once per tick, a dedicated connection runs SET SESSION tidb_isolation_read_engines='tiflash', then each of the 3 queries in DASHBOARD_QUERIES is timed with timed(); summarize() over that tick's samples gives p50.

metrics.label: Dashboard query p99 (TiFlash)
metrics.howMeasured: Same measurement as dashboard-p50-tiflash; this is the p99 field of the same summarize() result for the tick.

metrics.label: Order write p99
metrics.howMeasured: Every order INSERT is timed with timed() and pushed into a createSampleWindow(); summarize() over that tick's drained samples gives write-p99.

metrics.label: Write p99 degradation under dashboard load
metrics.howMeasured: degradationPct({ baselineP99Ms, currentP99Ms }) from src/metrics.ts; baseline is the write-p99 value captured during the seed-baseline phase.

metrics.label: Data freshness (write to visible)
metrics.howMeasured: freshnessMs({ committedAtMs, visibleAtMs }) from src/metrics.ts: committedAtMs is emitter.elapsedMs() right after a heartbeat order's INSERT commits; visibleAtMs is emitter.elapsedMs() at the first tick a TiFlash-forced probe query returns that row.

metrics.label: TiFlash replica sync progress
metrics.howMeasured: SELECT AVAILABLE, PROGRESS FROM information_schema.tiflash_replica WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = 'orders', once per tick; PROGRESS (0.0-1.0) times 100.

metrics.label: Orders written
metrics.howMeasured: Cumulative count of committed INSERTs against orders since the runner started, incremented once per successful write.

phases.label: Why this demo
phases.narration: A business team wants a live dashboard on operational orders, not a copy that is a day old. One TiDB cluster is about to serve both the checkout writes and the report.

phases.label: Baseline writes
phases.narration: Orders are flowing into TiDB now, no dashboard load yet. This write p99 is the baseline we compare against once the dashboard starts querying.

phases.label: Add the TiFlash replica
phases.narration: Adding a TiFlash replica to the orders table live: this is the columnar copy the dashboard will read from, syncing from the same rows being written right now.

phases.label: Dashboard load on TiKV
phases.narration: Routing the dashboard's query set at TiKV, the same engine handling the writes. Watch the write p99 line: this is what a warehouse-free dashboard used to cost you.

phases.label: Dashboard load on TiFlash
phases.narration: Same dashboard queries, same concurrency, now routed to TiFlash. Write p99 comes back down: the analytical load is isolated on its own replica.

phases.label: Freshness check
phases.narration: A heartbeat order just committed. Watch how many milliseconds until it is visible in a TiFlash-routed dashboard query - that is the real replication lag, not a marketing number.

phases.label: The real Power BI report
phases.narration: Cutting to a real Power BI Desktop report connected to this same cluster. Refreshing it pulls in the orders written during this run.

phases.label: Recap
phases.narration: No nightly ETL job, one cluster, a dashboard that is current to the second, and writes that never noticed the analytics running next to them.

checks.label: TiFlash replica available
checks.description: Passes once information_schema.tiflash_replica reports AVAILABLE = 1 for the orders table.

checks.label: TiKV and TiFlash totals match at a snapshot
checks.description: Passes when SUM(amount) AS OF TIMESTAMP <snapshot> for the orders table returns the identical value whether forced to read from TiKV or TiFlash.

checks.label: Write p99 stays within threshold under dashboard load
checks.description: Passes when the write-p99-degradation metric is at or below WRITE_P99_DEGRADATION_THRESHOLD_PCT while the dashboard is routed to TiFlash.

controls.label: Start dashboard load
controls.description: Begins the heavier concurrent replay (DASHBOARD_LOAD_CONCURRENCY workers per tick) of the dashboard query set against whichever engine is currently routed.

controls.label: Route dashboard to TiKV
controls.description: Points the heavier dashboard load at TiKV, the same engine serving writes.

controls.label: Route dashboard to TiFlash
controls.description: Points the heavier dashboard load at the TiFlash replica, isolated from the write path.

controls.label: Write burst
controls.description: Multiplies the order write rate by WRITE_BURST_FACTOR for WRITE_BURST_DURATION_MS.
